optimized.name: correct
optimized.description: Official per-answer objective; past scalar measurements train LDM methods, while blind baselines never expose them

settings.feedback: Blind baselines: public syntax only. LDM: past same-question scalar correctness, never private targets or judge internals.
settings.ldm_protocol: measured_correctness_optimization; distinct from official blind refinement
settings.source_commit_note: Archive contains no Git metadata; SHA-256 inventory pins local files.

proposal_modes.real: Explicit Responses or Chat Completions with matched reasoning controls; preflight required
proposal_modes.harness: Persistent sample-isolated Pi Harness sessions; Responses provider; task-local submission repair
proposal_modes.harness_public_audit: Independent compiled public-audit prior; no objective history or fitted GP
proposal_modes.ldm: Direct measured-feedback reservoir; empirical q0, fixed residual RBF GP/UCB and Gumbel sampling
proposal_modes.ldm_harness: Persistent research reservoir with the same measured-feedback LDM selector
proposal_modes.ldm_harness_compiled: Independent policy session compiles prior_mean@1 and ldm_weights@1 on actual measured history; fixed GP/UCB and sampling

collection_modes.cif: Accepted parseable CIF output → canonical ldm-2.0 IR
collection_modes.operations: Raw plans/tool records only; no CIF model-output collection

settings.harness_feedback: Sample-isolated research; measured-feedback LDM additionally exposes only past scalar correctness. Never mount judge artifacts, targets or cross-question answers.
settings.harness_selection: Blind harness uses predeclared profile rotation. LDM samples q0^alpha exp(eta robust_z(UCB)) from the maintained pool; last scheduled selected answer remains final.

per_candidate_limits.official_inference_token_budget: unspecified; our configs label their token cap

one_shot.description: One answer per released question; 8192 output-token cap, no target feedback

extended_reasoning.description: Four chronological target-blind self-review turns; final turn scored separately

extended_operations.description: Four target-blind JSON operation plans executed with bounded geometry tools; distinct tool-assisted extension
